# Session Notes

## Purpose
This file contains historical summaries of completed development sessions. Each entry documents what was accomplished, key findings, and outcomes. This creates a chronological record of the project's development journey.

## Template

```markdown
## Session: [Date or Step Number] - [Brief Title]

### Accomplished
- [Major task completed]
- [Feature implemented]
- [Bug fixed]

### Key Findings
- [Important discovery]
- [Decision made]
- [Lesson learned]

### Outcomes
- [Tests passing: X/Y]
- [Features working]
- [Ready for next step]
```

---

## Example Session

## Session: 2024-02-01 - Initial Project Setup

### Accomplished
- Forked repository and opened in Codespaces
- Reviewed project structure and documentation
- Ran initial tests to identify intentional bugs
- Set up development environment

### Key Findings
- Backend has 15 test failures (intentional for learning)
- Frontend has minimal test coverage
- Both backend and frontend have ESLint violations
- Project uses monorepo structure with npm workspaces

### Outcomes
- Environment ready for development
- Tests running: 0/15 passing (backend), 1/1 passing (frontend)
- Identified 5 major backend bugs to fix
- Identified 7 frontend issues to address
- Ready to begin Step 5-1: TDD Workflow
